title: Parliamentarian

inlines.v: PARLIAMENTA'RIAN PARLIAMENT'ARY, adjective Pertaining to parliament; as parliamentary authority. 1. Enacted or done by parliament; as a parliamentary act. 2. According to the rules and usages of parliament, or to the rules and customs of legislative bodies.
